landmarks.name: Queen Elizabeth II Library
facts: It is the main library on the St. John's campus.

landmarks.name: John C Perlin Arts and Culture Centre
University Centre
facts: It is home to the food court, the bookstore, the Breezeway campus bar and the campus radio station.

landmarks.name: Coughlan College
facts: It was originally one of four denominational residences, and became part of Paton College in the mid-1990s.

landmarks.name: Shiwak Hall
facts: It is a residential wing named in 2014 after a Labrador Inuit soldier of the First World War.

landmarks.name: R. Gushue Hall
facts: It is the dining hall for students in residence.

landmarks.name: Squires
facts: It is a residence house that switched from all-female to co-ed in 2008.
